nhse01.title: Nine Invites
nhse01.caption: When every weekend in December fills up, it's easy to forget you're allowed to say no. Pick the gatherings you'd truly miss, send a warm note to the rest, and keep one day just for rest.

nhse02.title: Small Budget, Big Heart
nhse02.caption: Worried your gift isn't big enough? The ones people keep are the ones that prove you were listening. Think back to something they loved this year and make it personal.

nhse03.title: Plus-One Short
nhse03.caption: Walking into a party of couples on your own can feel lonely for about five minutes. You're not missing a half. Go say hi to someone new, and maybe the host's dog.

nhse04.title: Social Battery: 2%
nhse04.caption: If the party is loud and you're running on empty, you don't have to hide in the coat pile. Tell someone you're stepping out for ten quiet minutes, then come back when you're ready.

nhse05.title: Out of Office
nhse05.caption: Still answering work messages at the holiday table? Set the auto-reply and trust it. The work will wait for you, and the people beside you are only here for a little while.

nhse06.title: It's a Gift Swap, Not a Final
nhse06.caption: Gift swaps get competitive fast. The best part was never the prize: it's laughing together when the plan falls apart. Play to have fun, and let the candle go.

nhse07.title: Guests in Ten Minutes
nhse07.caption:
Hosting doesn't mean doing it all yourself. When guests offer to help, say yes: most people love having a small job. A kitchen full of friends is the whole point.
Save this for your next dinner.

nhse08.title: Delayed. Again.
nhse08.caption: Travel delays can leave you apologising to everyone, even the departure board. A delay isn't your fault. Send one kind update home, find a snack, and let yourself rest.

nhse09.title: Two Time Zones
nhse09.caption: Spending the holidays far apart is hard when your clocks don't even agree. Choose one small thing to share at the same moment, like the same dessert, and it starts to feel like a date.

nhse10.title: Plans Cancelled
nhse10.caption: Dressed up and then the plans fall through? It's okay to feel let down. Let yourself feel it, then make a small cozy plan for the night and a kind rain check for another day.

nhse11.title: Cried at a Mitten
nhse11.caption: This time of year can bring up a lot, and tiny things might set off big feelings. That's normal. Drink some water, take a short walk, and reach out to someone who understands you.

nhse12.title: Matching Sweaters
nhse12.caption: Your partner loves an idea that you're not quite comfortable with? Be honest about what feels right for you, then find the version you'll both enjoy. Compromise can be cozy.
